title: Exact-key logical-precedence collision repair
finding_before_repair: The prospective forced-fingerprint-collision gate showed two keys with distinct model_id values comparing equal under b110_adaptive_hydraulic_keys_equal.
root_cause: The ksatexm_extension_enabled .eqv. comparison was embedded without parentheses in an .and. chain. Fortran logical precedence allows the expression to group across .eqv., so with false extension flags the intended field-by-field conjunction is not preserved.
repair: Parenthesize the .eqv. field comparison so every key field, including model_id and all 42 coefficient bit patterns, remains conjunctive.
gates: forced equal-fingerprint distinct-model_id keys compare unequal
both forced-collision keys build as separate registry entries
subsequent exact-key retrieval hits the correct entry
F-AHL32A 10000-key probe gates remain mean<=4 and max<=128
F-AHL29 and F-AHL28B semantic regressions remain PASS
